nwf_note: No nonsense-word subtest at this lesson. 0 candidate spellings are legal here; every one of them is rejected because it is heard as a real word, a respelling or a letter name. instrument_claim: Decoding check on this lesson's taught sound. NOT a clean alternate form: below Lesson 13 the published Form A already spends every on-target word that exists, so some overlap is unavoidable and a child who practised at home may have met these words. Read the score as 'can they decode these taught patterns', not as an independent re-test. Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
